# Swarm & Bee

> Swarm & Bee builds sovereign AI infrastructure that runs where customer data lives.

Canonical site: https://swarmandbee.ai/

Hugging Face: https://huggingface.co/SwarmandBee

## Primary capabilities

- SwarmMed AI: private medical-imaging workflow support for local edge deployment and clinician review.
- Edge AI appliances: integrated GPU compute, local storage, networking, and private inference.
- AI hosting: high-memory NVIDIA Blackwell infrastructure for controlled inference and model workloads.
- Sovereign data systems: local-first architecture designed to minimize unnecessary data transit.
- Verifiable execution: model, node, timing, input fingerprint, and output hash can form a cryptographic job receipt.

## Important product boundaries

SwarmMed AI is presented for research and workflow support. It is not presented as an autonomous diagnosis system or a medical device. Qualified clinicians remain responsible for medical interpretation and decisions.
